abstract: UltraCare is a posed-based fall detection and emergency alert system that is designed to improve safety for elderly and high-risked individuals by detecting fall automatically and notifying caregivers in real time. The system processes live video from a CCTV/RTSP camera and uses a human pose estimation model to track key points and movement patterns. To reduce false alarms, it applies a hybrid fall decision method that combines multiple signals such as posture change (from standing to lying), body orientation, sudden head drop, and motion intensity across consecutive frames. Once a fall is detected and confirmed, the system triggers an event notification to a backend server and upload a short video clip as the evidence for faster verification and response. The solution is designed with practical development in mind, supporting continuous monitoring, cooldown control to prevent repeated alerts. Overall, UltraCare provides a reliable and scalable approach to automatic fall detection that helps shorten and quick response time to reduce the risk of severe injury in real-world care environments.

canonical_title: Hotel Reservation and Operational Management System for Convenient Park Sukhumvit Hotel
abstract:
Convenient Park Hotel Management System is developed in collaboration with the hotel to help in managing hotel operations, guest bookings, and internal communication workflows.

It provides a centralized platform where guests can browse available rooms, make reservations, and submit service requests directly from the website and LINE, while hotel administrators can manage room inventory, track bookings, process payments, and handle guest complaints in real time. The system generates structured booking records, payment confirmations, and notification alerts, complete with real-time status updates across all connected users.

With a public-facing website, a guest-facing booking application, a comprehensive admin dashboard, and a robust backend API, Convenient Park Hotel Management System ensures that every aspect of hotel operations — from room allocation and meeting room scheduling to guest service request resolution via LINE messaging — is handled accurately and efficiently.

The system is expected to help the hotel in streamlining front-desk operations, improving guest experience, and maintaining clear and consistent communication between staff and guests, which will significantly reduce the amount of time used up for manual processes and increase the productivity and service quality.

canonical_title: DTG FieldLink - Ticket Management for ISP Maintenance Group
abstract:
This report details the design, development, and implementation of DTG FieldLink, a custom-engineered Field Service Management System (FSMS) created for DTG Co. Ltd., a third-party Internet Service Provider (ISP) maintenance company in Myanmar. Historically, the organization's operational workflow relied heavily on unstructured LINE messaging groups for team dispatching and manual Excel spreadsheet entries for record-keeping. This legacy process caused severe administrative bottlenecks, including continuous data duplication, a lack of real-time field coordination, and error-prone manual calculations for monthly ISP material reimbursements.

To resolve these inefficiencies, a dual-platform digital solution was developed, consisting of a Next.js Admin Web Application for centralized dispatching and a Flutter-based Android Mobile Application for on-site field technicians. Powered by a Node.js backend and a PostgreSQL database hosted on DigitalOcean, the system automates the ticketing lifecycle. It replaces manual chat pings with real-time Firebase push notifications and eliminates the need for manual geographical matching by automatically rendering KMZ/GeoJSON spatial data directly over Google Maps on the technicians' mobile devices.

Furthermore, the system was tailored to fulfill specific client requirements, including precise ticket breaktime tracking to evaluate genuine team efficiency and an automated financial reporting module that exports formatted Excel invoices for seamless ISP reimbursements. Ultimately, DTG FieldLink successfully eradicates manual administrative data duplication, accelerates issue resolution, and provides management with the data-driven analytics necessary for scalable enterprise growth.
